content.short: Proof of Capital is an initiative focused on verifying liquidity and supporting the growth of TON projects.
content.description: Proof of Capital is a dedicated initiative and support system within the TON ecosystem, focused on enhancing the transparency and reliability of project liquidity. It provides a framework for projects to verify their capital and on-chain assets, building trust with potential investors and the broader community. Additionally, Proof of Capital often functions as an accelerator, providing strategic guidance and resources to high-potential TON startups. By fostering a more transparent financial environment, it plays a critical role in the network's overall stability and professional growth.
